reviews.reason: 独立 Agent 评审完成；评分是基于本次证据的意见，不替代业务 QA 或人工评审。
reviews.summary: 本评审独立评估 NocoBase3 基座对“客户备忘录”内网系统的四个能力面：数据持久化与结构初始化、服务端 API 路由与鉴权、客户端路由与浮层/表单组装、客户端国际化与语言切换。冻结快照中的框架库、插件与 Skill/文档整体能直接或经正常组合支撑 B01–B06：Migration builder 建表、Repository CRUD、filter/sort 构建器、defineApiRoutes + auth.required、defineAppRoutes 子路由浮层约定、@nocobase/i18n 运行时与 app-plugin-i18n 切换控件均有实证代码与指引。发现一处文档与实现不符（SKILL 声称路由侧 Repository writePolicy 默认 false，实际默认 true 且无路由侧机制自动收紧），以及 AGENTS.md 对 generated collection 产物的描述易误导；示例 seed 的幂等实现存在并发隐患但属应用层。UI 维度因评审模型无法查看截图而未评，界面质量不作为分数背书。

entrypoints: migrations 与 seeds 的绝对规则
Repository 与 Query 方法及边界
managed / external 连接的 collections 产物归属

targets.name: app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-development/references/migrations.md
entrypoints: migrations 建结构、seeds 插数据
seed 可复现、不得静默覆盖

targets.name: app/AGENTS.md
entrypoints: database/<connection>/collections/ 产物的定位与生成方式

modules.scope: 客户备忘录记录的表结构创建、3 条示例数据写入、增删改查与按客户名部分匹配查询的底层能力。
modules.limitations: 未在实际数据库上复跑 migrate/seed，迁移与幂等行为的运行时表现仅由浏览器验收报告与应用逻辑推断；@nocobase/db 的源码以 dist JS 形式冻结，未核对 TypeScript 源。

requirements.need: 备忘录记录真实落库：新增、编辑、删除、列表查询持久化到数据库。
requirements.responsibility: 框架提供 Migration builder 建表与 Repository CRUD；应用声明字段、约束与校验。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 用 defineMigration + builder.createCollection 定义结构，用 database.repository(collection) 执行增删改查。
requirements.actualUsage: 迁移用 builder.createCollection 声明 string/text/datetime/主键/索引；路由用 repository.findMany/createOne/updateOne/deleteOne。

requirements.need: 按客户名部分匹配搜索；清空搜索后恢复完整列表。
requirements.responsibility: 框架提供过滤构建器；应用在列表端点组合过滤条件。
requirements.recommendedUsage: filter.string('name').includes(value, { mode: 'insensitive' })；无搜索词时不传 filter。
requirements.actualUsage: 路由在 search 非空时使用该 API，空时 filter 为 undefined；清空输入后重新取全量。

requirements.need: 写入 3 条示例记录，重复运行 seed 不产生重复或覆盖用户改动。
requirements.responsibility: 框架提供 defineSeed 与 upsertOne/唯一约束；应用决定幂等键与约束。
requirements.recommendedUsage: seed 以稳定业务值为键、由唯一约束兜底，用 upsertOne 直接表达幂等。
requirements.actualUsage: seed 用按 name 的查询存在性检查跳过已存在记录；未声明唯一约束，也未使用 upsertOne。

requirements.need: 列表按创建时间倒序稳定排序，并有索引支撑。
requirements.responsibility: 框架提供排序构建器与索引声明；应用选择排序字段。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 迁移中声明索引，查询用 sort.field('createdAt').desc()。
requirements.actualUsage: 迁移为 createdAt 建索引，列表查询按 createdAt 降序。

requirementFit.reason: 建表、CRUD、部分匹配过滤与排序都有直接 API，应用实际写法与框架推荐用法一致；仅 seed 幂等靠查询绕过，未用框架给出的唯一约束+upsertOne 组合。

usability.reason: Repository 上下文（builder/query/repository 分工）与 filter/sort 构建器都很直观，指引说明了“查询放 service、不裸露原始行”，上手成本低。

agentFriendliness.reason: SKILL 把 migration/seed 的硬规则逐条写明并给出反例，使得 agent 能一次写对；但 collections 产物归属在 managed/external 之间的差异分散在 SKILL 与 AGENTS.md，容易被误读。

design.reason: 结构变更走迁移、查询走构建器、写策略与权限分离，边界清晰；writePolicy 默认不限制的安全责任被明确交给路由/调用方，设计上自洽。

reliability.reason: 实现完整：writePolicy 默认值在实现与类型注释中一致，迁移/种子运行机制与索引声明均落在代码；但默认不限制写入使误用风险依赖调用方自觉。

modules.name: 服务端 API 路由与鉴权

targets.name: app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-development/references/server-routes.md
entrypoints: defineApiRoutes 与 defineRootRoutes 的区别

modules.scope: 浏览器可调用的 /api/customer-memos CRUD 与搜索端点，以及这些端点的鉴权与写入范围控制。
modules.limitations: 未实际启动服务或发起请求验证 401/鉴权时序；端点的权限与写入范围结论来自静态阅读与浏览器验收报告的间接证据。

requirements.need: 浏览器可调用的 CRUD+搜索 API（列表/创建/查看/更新/删除）。
requirements.responsibility: 框架提供 defineApiRoutes 路由贡献与 Hono 运行时；应用实现端点、DTO 与校验。
requirements.recommendedUsage: defineApiRoutes 工厂返回自带 Hono 路由；标准 CRUD 可用 defineRepositoryApiRoutes 声明式暴露。
requirements.actualUsage: 用 defineApiRoutes 手写 Hono 处理器，调用 database.repository 完成增删改查与搜索。

requirements.need: 端点必须鉴权，匿名访问被拒绝（401）。
requirements.responsibility: 框架提供 authenticationToken 与 auth.required() 中间件；应用把它挂到路由上。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 在隔离的子路由上 memos.use('*', authentication.required())，不依赖他人中间件。
requirements.actualUsage: 在 /customer-memos 子路由上统一挂载 authentication.required()。

requirements.need: 写操作受字段白名单/授权策略约束，避免越权写入。
requirements.responsibility: 框架提供 Repository writePolicy 与 defineRepositoryApiRoutes 的强制 policy；应用声明可写字段或 allow list。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 用 defineRepositoryApiRoutes 声明 policy；或手写路由时显式设置 writePolicy/用 withPolicy 限定可写字段。
requirements.actualUsage: 手写路由只做输入字段校验，未设置 writePolicy；SKILL 声称路由侧默认 false，实际默认 true 且无路由侧自动收紧机制。

requirementFit.reason: 路由贡献 API 与鉴权中间件足以直接实现带搜索的 CRUD；写入范围控制有现成能力（policy/writePolicy），应用未使用但能力不缺。

usability.reason: defineApiRoutes + container 解析依赖的写法简洁，指引把认证端点与“每条路由自担安全”讲清楚；手写路由时错误处理需自行搭建是其成本。

agentFriendliness.reason: server-routes.md 给出可直接照抄的模板与明确禁则，利于 agent 一次写对；但 Repository 写策略的文档说法与实现不符，agent 照文档判断会误以为路由侧已安全。

design.reason: 路由贡献与中间件解耦、policy 对 defineRepositoryApiRoutes 强制显式声明，设计上把安全默认值放在声明式入口；代价是手写路由路径默认不设限。

reliability.reason: auth.required() 的 401 行为与未授权处理在实现中清晰完整；写入策略在路由场景依赖调用方，框架侧无自动兜底。

targets.name: app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-development/references/frontend/frontend-dev.md
entrypoints: Common mistakes（hook 位置、浮层、authz、搜索框绑定、setState in effect、确认框闪烁）

modules.scope: 列表页、导航、新增/查看/编辑子路由浮层、删除二次确认与搜索交互的前端组装能力。
modules.limitations: UI 视觉与真实浏览器交互未由本次评审验证（评审模型无法读取截图）；客户端行为结论来自静态阅读、指引与浏览器验收报告，未复跑。

requirements.need: 导航进入列表，新增（对话框）/查看（抽屉）/编辑（对话框）页面可达且刷新可恢复。
requirements.responsibility: 框架提供 defineAppRoutes 与子路由浮层约定（RouteDialog/RouteDrawer）；应用声明路由树。
requirements.recommendedUsage: client/routes.ts 用 defineAppRoutes 声明父子路由，浮层开合由 URL 决定而非组件 open 状态。
requirements.actualUsage: routes.ts 声明 customer-memos 顶层路由及 new、:memoId、edit 子路由；分别用对话框/抽屉表达。

requirements.need: 搜索输入对中文输入法稳定，清空后恢复完整列表。
requirements.responsibility: 框架在 table.md 给出受控输入 + 防抖 + URL 参数方案；应用在列表页实现。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 文本留组件状态，isComposing 时不计入，防抖后写 URL；清空移除 q 并重取。
requirements.actualUsage: 列表页用 useSearchParams 保存 q，配合防抖与清空按钮，并在请求与“是否有过滤”判断时 trim。

requirements.need: 删除需二次确认；取消保留记录，确认并刷新后记录消失。
requirements.responsibility: 框架指引用 AlertDialog 承载单动作确认并把状态与目标分开；应用实现交互。
requirements.recommendedUsage: overlay.md：单动作确认用 AlertDialog（组件状态），关闭时只改 open 以免标题闪烁。
requirements.actualUsage: 列表页用 AlertDialog 确认后调用删除接口并刷新列表。

requirementFit.reason: defineAppRoutes 的声明式路由与共享 useApiClient 足以直接支撑列表/新增/查看/编辑/删除；浮层与搜索交互均有框架约定可循。

usability.reason: 组件与浮层选型有明确对照表，常见错误清单前置了 hook、authz、输入法等高频坑，显著降低组装成本。

agentFriendliness.reason: table/api/overlay 三份参考把 URL 搜索、取数模板与浮层结构写到了可照抄的粒度，并指出 tsc/单步 fill() 抓不到的输入法问题，agent 能据此写对。

design.reason: 路由贡献冻结、浮层由 URL 驱动、API 客户端经 service token 共享，整体一致；部分 UI 原语（DataTable/PageContainer）由应用模板提供，框架侧只保证组合契约。

reliability.reason: 路由贡献与 useApiClient 的实现稳定且有冻结与 token 约束；但搜索/确认等交互的正确性主要靠文档约束，框架不提供强制检查。

modules.name: 客户端国际化与语言切换
modules.scope: 客户备忘录界面文案的中英文资源、按命名空间渲染翻译，以及单页语言切换与持久化。
modules.limitations: 未实际在浏览器切换语言或验证服务端回退文案；语言行为结论来自代码、指引与浏览器验收报告（B06 通过）。

requirements.need: 导航、字段、按钮与校验提示均走现有翻译机制，无硬编码文案。
requirements.responsibility: 框架提供 useTranslation 与 LocaleResource 派生类型；应用在 locale 文件声明键。
requirements.recommendedUsage: en-US.ts 定义结构与导出类型，其他语言用该类型标注（拼错/缺键即编译错误），组件用 useTranslation。
requirements.actualUsage: client/locales/en-US.ts 与 zh-CN.ts 的 customerMemos 分组逐键覆盖标题、按钮与成功提示。

requirements.need: 单页可切换中英文，界面文案随之切换。
requirements.responsibility: 框架提供 useLocale/changeLanguage 与 app-plugin-i18n 切换控件；应用提供语言开关。
requirements.recommendedUsage: useAppLocale() 切换：先加载并切换界面，再持久化并通知服务端；服务端回退不视为失败。
requirements.actualUsage: 使用 app-plugin-i18n 的 useAppLocale 完成浏览器与服务器语言一致。

requirementFit.reason: 命名空间翻译、类型化 locale 文件与切换控件齐备，直接满足中英文案与单页切换；未翻译键有明确回退链。

usability.reason: useTranslation/useLocale 的调用面小，无 runtime 时安全降级；语言列表由文件驱动，无需额外配置。

agentFriendliness.reason: 两份 Skill/参考把“先 en-US 再其他语言、类型约束、键命名、回退链”讲到可执行粒度，agent 易落地；仍需人工留意 t() 键不受类型检查。

design.reason: 运行时先加载资源再切换以保证原子性，类型从英文结构派生，客户端/服务端语言列表解耦且回退明确，层次分明。

reliability.reason: 切换实现含加载后切换与错误态回滚保护，服务端会话同步有失败容忍；实现完整且注释说明了边界。

findings.title: nocobase-db SKILL 声称路由侧 Repository 的 writePolicy 默认 false，实际默认 true 且无路由侧自动收紧
findings.detail: packages/@nocobase/db/skills/nocobase-db/SKILL.md:248 写“writePolicy defaults to true for an internal Repository and false for one reached from an API route, so a route-facing Repository needs an explicit allow list”。但 @nocobase/db 实现中 validateMutation 使用 `options.writePolicy === undefined ? true : options.writePolicy`（repository.js:236 等），类型注释（types.d.ts:41）也写明“省略或 true 不增加写入限制”。全包检索未发现任何基于请求上下文（如 AsyncLocalStorage/requestConstraint）在路由侧把默认值置为 false 的机制；真正强制显式策略的是 defineRepositoryApiRoutes（repository-routes.js:60 对缺失 policy 直接抛错）。因此手写路由拿到的 Repository 默认不做写入约束。
findings.impact: 照文档判断的开发者或 agent 会以为手写路由的写操作已受默认策略保护，从而省去 allow list，导致字段越权写入风险；应用当前正属于这种手写路由场景。
findings.suggestedChange: 把 SKILL.md:248 改为“writePolicy 默认 true，任何进入路径都不自动设限；只有 defineRepositoryApiRoutes 会强制每条 exposure 显式声明 policy，手写路由必须自行传 writePolicy 或使用 withPolicy”，并补一个路由侧显式 allow list 的示例。
findings.claimed: 来自 API 路由的 Repository 默认 writePolicy=false，路由侧 Repository 自带显式 allow list 的必要性由默认值保证。
findings.observed: Repository 默认 writePolicy=true（不限制）；路由侧没有自动置 false 的机制，必须显式传 policy/writePolicy 或走 defineRepositoryApiRoutes 才有约束。

findings.title: app/AGENTS.md 对 database/<connection>/collections/ 的描述会误导默认模板用户

evidence.excerpt:
Each context carries its own tools, and which one to use is not a free choice — see [Repository and Query](#4-repository-and-query). In short: a migration works through `builder` and `query`, and a seed writes through `repository`.

The rules are absolute, because these files are history that has already run on other machines:

- **Self-contained.** Spell out every table, field, index, constraint and metadata operation in the file. Never import a Collection definition, model, registry or shared constant that keeps evolving — that silently changes both the behavior and the checksum of something already applied.
- **Immutable once merged.** Check with `git log -- <file>` if unsure. Before the branch is merged you may correct the file in place; after it, every change is a new, later file. Never hard-code a previous checksum to make an edited migration look untouched. Correcting it in place changes nothing on its own — it is recorded as executed, so a plain apply skips it and the database keeps the schema the old file produced. `pnpm db:redo` rolls the latest batch back and applies it again.
- **The file name body matches `name`**, and the name is unique across every source in the application.
- **Declare `irreversible: true`** when there is no real reverse operation, instead of writing a `down()` that quietly does nothing.
- **A seed is idempotent**, keyed on a stable business value backed by a unique constraint, so a repeated run is a no-op — `upsertOne` is the direct way to express that. A seed context has no `builder` at all, and a seed has no rollback or truncate behavior.

evidence.observation: 列出 Repository 全部方法与边界；line 248 声称 writePolicy 对内部 Repository 默认 true、对来自 API 路由的 Repository 默认 false，因此路由侧 Repository 需要显式 allow list。
evidence.excerpt:
The methods are `findOne`, `findMany`, `count`, `exists`, `aggregate`, `groupBy`, `createOne`, `createMany`, `updateOne`, `updateMany`, `upsertOne`, `deleteOne` and `deleteMany`; `describeMutation` and `validateMutation` report capabilities and pre-validate input, and `withPolicy` returns a scoped Repository.

Boundaries that are easy to get wrong:

- `findOne` takes the first match; `updateOne` and `deleteOne` require exactly one; `upsertOne` requires a unique equality condition.
- `updateMany` and `deleteMany` refuse an empty scope. Pass `all: true` only when the task explicitly calls for every row — never to make an error go away.
- `createMany` and `updateMany` do not accept nested relation writes. `createOne` accepts `create` and `connect` on a relation, not the full set.
- `disconnect` detaches; `delete` removes the target record. A relation target update or delete stays inside the current parent record's scope.
- Repository does not apply the application's permissions. A route handler decides what the caller may see and change _before_ anything reaches `filter`, `values` or `select`. `writePolicy` defaults to `true` for an internal Repository and `false` for one reached from an API route, so a route-facing Repository needs an explicit allow list.
- Do not assume an `id` exists, and do not infer a field's type, primary key or auto-increment from its name.

evidence.observation: 指引如何从 container 解析 databaseManagerToken、database.repository 为默认入口、查询应放 service、绝不多余地暴露原始行，并提醒 Repository/Query 不施加应用权限、由路由决定可见与可改范围。
evidence.excerpt:
Resolve `databaseManagerToken` from the container:

```ts
import { databaseManagerToken } from '@nocobase/db';

const database = app.container.resolve(databaseManagerToken);
```

In a route factory, resolve it once in the factory rather than inside each handler. In a service, take it as a constructor dependency — see [services and jobs](services-and-jobs.md).

From there, `database.repository(collection)` is the default for a collection's records and their relations, `database.query()` is for a result set that is not any collection's records, and `database.transaction(fn)` groups writes that must succeed or fail together. Each takes an optional connection name and uses the default connection when omitted.

Keep `@nocobase/db` in `dependencies`, not `devDependencies`. The deployed server resolves it at runtime, and TypeScript also reads that declaration to infer the database configuration through the public package name; declaring it only as a development dependency can cause TS2883 in an installed application even while a source workspace builds successfully.

## Where data access belongs

Put queries in a service and call the service from the route, once more than one handler needs the same data or the logic is worth testing on its own. A route that only reads and returns a list may query directly.

Never expose a raw row shape as an API response without deciding what belongs in it. Internal columns leak through a select-everything query.

Neither Repository nor Query applies the application's permissions. The route decides what the caller may see and change before any of it reaches a filter, a values object, or a field selection — see [application permission development](authorization.md).

evidence.observation: 说明 migrations 只建结构、seeds 只插数据；pnpm db:apply 应用两者；seeds 必须可复现且重复运行不得静默覆盖用户已改数据。
evidence.excerpt:
Migrations under `database/main/migrations/` are the application's schema history. Seeds under `database/main/seeds/` insert records the application requires to run. Migrations create structure. Seeds never do.

`database/tsconfig.json` extends the server configuration so editor tooling and ESLint recognize migrations and seeds as Node source. Keep it in place when adding connection directories.

## Running

```bash
pnpm db:apply
```

This applies pending migrations and then pending seeds for `database.default`, including registered plugins, ordered by name across all sources. Both halves run only what is pending, so on an already-migrated database it applies seeds alone. The template defaults to `main`. Plugin migrations, seeds and runtime default reads/writes always use this same connection; changing `database.default` changes the application system database.

Seeds are the second half of that run, so the structure a seed writes into must already exist from an earlier migration. Keep seed data fixed and reproducible — no current timestamps or random values in identifying fields — and never let a repeat run silently overwrite data a user has edited.

evidence.observation: defineSeed 的 run 先按 name 查询存在性（query.selectFrom('customerMemos').where('name','=',sample.name)），存在则 continue，否则 insertInto；未声明唯一约束，也未使用 upsertOne。
line 184 将 database/<connection>/collections/ 描述为“数据库当前解析结果”，声称由 pnpm collections:generate 生成、--check 在其过期时失败，并说每个文件都是派生产物。
evidence.excerpt: `database/<connection>/collections/` holds what the database currently resolves each Collection to — `collection.json`, `metadata.json` and `schema.json` per Collection plus a `_manifest.json` — written by `pnpm collections:generate` after migrating. Every file there is derived: edit metadata through migrations or the Collection Metadata Service and regenerate, never by hand, and never import these files from a migration. `pnpm collections:generate --check` fails when they are out of date.

evidence.observation: collections 产物的归属取决于 schemaManagement：managed 连接下为派生输出、被 gitignore、运行时无人读取；external 连接下才是被提交的输入。区分这与 AGENTS.md 不分连接的口径。
evidence.excerpt:
**`pnpm collections:generate` writes it to disk, for you to read.** It reads every Collection of a connection and writes `collection.json`, `metadata.json` and `schema.json` per Collection under `database/<connection>/collections/<name>/`, plus one `_manifest.json` for the connection. Run it after migrating and read the artifact before writing a query — it is the reliable way to learn the real field names, types, nullability, keys and relations instead of guessing them from a migration you have not read. `--connection <name>` and `--all` select connections; `--check` writes nothing and exits non-zero when the files are stale.

Who owns those files depends on `schemaManagement`, and this asymmetry matters:

| Connection | `database/<connection>/collections/`                                                                                                               |
| ---------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `managed`  | Derived output, gitignored. Migrations remain the only authority on schema, and nothing reads these files at runtime. Regenerate rather than edit. |
| `external` | Committed input. `metadata.json` is the default metadata source for a connection with no configured store — editing it changes runtime behavior.   |

So never edit a managed connection's artifacts to "fix" a schema — change the migration and regenerate. And never delete an external connection's, which would remove the metadata the application runs on.

evidence.excerpt:
## Common mistakes

- **Calling a hook outside a component**: `useApiClient()`, `useTranslation()`, `useState()` and other hooks can be called only at the top level of a component or custom hook, never at module top level, in an event handler, or inside a condition or loop.
- **Overlays that use component state**: create, edit and detail views must be child-route overlays; otherwise a link cannot open them directly and they disappear on refresh (see `references/overlay.md`).
- **Calling `useRouteOverlay()` in the component that renders the overlay**: it can be called only from a child component inside `RouteDialog`/`RouteDrawer` (see `references/overlay.md`).
- **Overwriting the routes file**: append to the existing array in `client/routes.ts`; do not replace the whole file, or the home page and the sign-in page disappear with it.
- **Forgetting to update the route test**: `tests/logic/client-routes.test.ts` pins the route names of pages that require sign-in. After adding such a page (including a child route), add its name there, or the test fails (see section 12 of `references/page.md`).
- **Missing `authz`**: every page, including child routes, declares `authz`; registration rejects one without it. For a page every signed-in user can use, write `authz: 'skip'`; otherwise check `{ resource: { type: 'page', id }, action: 'access' }` (see `references/page.md`).
- **Hard-coded colors or copy**: see `references/styling.md` and `references/i18n.md`.
- **Prefixes in endpoint paths**: the `path` passed to `api.request` includes neither `/api` nor `/main`.
- **Type errors from `useForm`**: do not write `useForm<z.infer<typeof schema>>`; let it infer the type from `zodResolver(schema)` (see `references/form.md`).
- **Binding the search box to the URL**: do not take the input's `value` directly from a URL parameter, or Chinese input methods break (see `references/table.md`).
- **Syncing state in an effect**: this application enables the `@eslint-react/set-state-in-effect` rule, so calling `setState` synchronously inside an effect fails lint. When loading data, call `setState` only in the request callbacks (see `references/api.md`); for "update state when props or the URL change", compare with the previous value during render and update there instead.
- **The confirmation dialog title flickers as it closes**: store the open state and the target (the record to delete) separately, and change only the open state when closing (see `references/overlay.md`).

evidence.observation: 浮层选型表：创建/编辑短表单用 RouteDialog（子路由）、详情用 RouteDrawer、单动作确信用 AlertDialog（组件状态）、临时面板用 Sheet；并给出“先声明子路由→父页放 Outlet→子页包 RouteDialog/RouteDrawer→useRouteOverlay 关闭”的标准顺序。
evidence.excerpt:
## 1. Choosing an overlay

| Use case                                                                   | Component                      | Where the open state lives |
| -------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------ | -------------------------- |
| Create, edit (short form)                                                  | `RouteDialog` (child route)    | URL                        |
| Record detail view, inspector                                              | `RouteDrawer` (child route)    | URL                        |
| Child page that covers the content area (non-modal)                        | `RouteChildPage` (child route) | URL                        |
| Confirm one action (delete, deactivate, etc.)                              | `AlertDialog`                  | Component state            |
| Temporary panel that represents no record or location (explanations, help) | `Sheet`                        | Component state            |

- **Build dialogs and drawers that represent a page, form, editor or detail view as child routes by default**, even when the user does not mention "routing": a link opens them directly, a refresh restores them, and browser back and forward work. Follow an explicit user request for a different interaction.
- For these overlays, do not use an `open` state inside the component, do not add an `open` prop to `RouteDialog`/`RouteDrawer`, and do not build a separate route-overlay implementation. Route matching decides whether the overlay exists: the child route's URL opens it, and the parent route's URL closes it.
- Only a confirmation of a single action (`AlertDialog`) and a temporary panel (`Sheet`) use component state.
- `RouteChildPage` covers the content area and is not modal, so the sidebar and header stay usable; see `child-routes.md`.
- Stacking: a drawer can open dialogs and confirmation dialogs on top of it; a dialog can open only a confirmation dialog on top of it. Esc and clicking the backdrop close only the topmost layer (guideline I1).

Component locations: `@/components/route-dialog`, `@/components/route-drawer`, `@/components/use-route-overlay`, `@/components/ui/alert-dialog`, `@/components/ui/sheet`.

## 2. Overlays as child routes

Work in this order:

1. Declare the child routes in `client/routes.ts`.
2. Place `<Outlet />` in the parent page and pass the refresh function down through `context`.
3. In the child route's page, wrap the content in `RouteDialog` or `RouteDrawer`.
4. Close the overlay by calling `useRouteOverlay()` in a component inside it.
5. When closing needs a check first (a submission in progress, unsaved changes), add `beforeClose`.

### 2.1 Declare the child routes

## 5. Writing search and filters to the URL

The search term and filter values live in URL query parameters (`?q=…&status=…`), so a refresh, going back or a shared link restores them (guideline T1.7). Request parameters follow the URL, not the input.

- The search box's `placeholder` says which fields can be searched (guideline T1.1), for example "Search by name or owner". Both the search box and the filter controls need an `aria-label`.
- Write the search logic directly in the list page component; do not extract it into an application-wide hook or utility file.

### Do not bind the search box directly to the URL

Do not write `value={searchParams.get('q')}` together with a `setSearchParams` call in `onChange`. React Router changes the URL inside a transition, and between two keystrokes React resets the input to the old URL value: a Chinese input method leaves a string of raw pinyin in the box, the cursor jumps to the end when you edit in the middle, and fast typing drops characters (violating guideline A7). `tsc`, ESLint and tests that fill in a value in one step (such as Playwright's `fill()`) cannot catch this; verify with real character-by-character typing and an input method.

### How to write it

The names below match the variables and functions in the code in section 10.

1. **Keep the input's text in component state** (`text`). `onChange` updates `text` and starts a 300ms timer (`scheduleSearch`, guideline I5).
2. **No timer during composition**: `onChange` checks `event.nativeEvent.isComposing`, because pinyin that is still being composed is not a search term; `onCompositionEnd` starts the timer once a candidate is picked and confirmed.
3. **Write to the URL only after typing stops**: when the timer fires, `updateParams` sets or deletes `q` and writes with `{ replace: true }`, so going back does not step through every search term one by one. The URL keeps the input exactly as typed (spaces included); the request and the "are there any filters" check use the value after `trim()`.
4. **Base URL writes on the latest parameters**: `paramsRef` holds the parameters this page last wrote or the router last updated, and `updateParams` modifies those. Do not use `setSearchParams((prev) => …)`: the function form receives the parameters of the render that issued the call, so when the search timer fires and the status changes at almost the same moment, the two writes overwrite each other.
5. **Sync back into the input on back and forward**: during render, compare against the last `q` seen (`seenSearch`) and update `text` when it has changed. Do not `setState` in an effect; the project enables `@eslint-react/set-state-in-effect`.
6. **The page's own writes must not overwrite the input**: a `q` written by this page reaches the component only after the transition commits, and by then the user may have typed a few more characters. `ownSearch` remembers the value this page last wrote; when the value coming back from the URL equals it, leave the input alone.
7. **Drop the write if navigation changed the parameters while the timer ran**: record `q` when the timer starts; if it has changed when the timer fires (back, forward, a clicked menu link), the navigation result wins. The address bar changes immediately on navigation, but the router parameters update only after the transition commits, possibly after the timer fires, so check both `paramsRef` and `window.location.search`.
8. **Status filter**: pass `items` to `Select`; the value `'all'` means no filter. `onValueChange` may emit `null`; treat it as no filter. An unrecognized value in the URL also counts as no filter (`isProjectStatus`).

### Clear filters

- Whether the button shows depends on the input's current text (`hasFilters` uses `text`), so it appears as soon as the first character is typed (guideline T1.2).
- Clicking it cancels the timer, clears `text` and `ownSearch`, and removes `q` and `status` from the URL.
- The button disappears along with the filters and focus moves to the search box (guideline A6), which is why the search box has `ref={searchRef}`.

evidence.excerpt:
## Adding a string

1. Find the package that owns the text. Application text goes in `client/locales/`; a plugin's text goes in that plugin's `client/locales/`.
2. Add the key to `en-US.ts`. The structure is written once: the type is derived from the value with `LocaleResource<typeof enUS>`, and other locales are annotated with it, which is what makes a typo a compile error.
3. Add the translation to every other locale file. A missing key falls back rather than breaking, so this can lag, and `typecheck` reports it.
4. Render it with `useTranslation` from `@nocobase/i18n/client`.

```tsx
import { useTranslation } from '@nocobase/i18n/client';

const { t } = useTranslation();
t('actions.save');
```

Keys nest and are addressed with dots: `t('trigger.types.schedule')`.

## Naming translation keys

Use short semantic keys that describe the purpose of the text and stay valid when its wording changes. Use lower camelCase within each segment and dots for useful feature or context groups, such as `files.uploadFailed` or `demo.pageDescription`. A small namespace may use `title` directly. Do not use complete English sentences as keys or merely convert a sentence into camelCase.

| Purpose              | Prefer                        | Avoid                                       |
| -------------------- | ----------------------------- | ------------------------------------------- |
| Page heading         | `orders.title`                | `Order list`                                |
| Empty state          | `orders.empty`                | `orders.noOrdersHaveBeenCreatedYet`         |
| Upload error         | `files.uploadFailed`          | `File upload failed.`                       |
| Demo explanation     | `demo.pageDescription`        | `This page demonstrates the plugin.`        |
| Action versus status | `actions.open`, `status.open` | Sharing `open` just because both say “Open” |

Follow existing semantic groups and reuse keys only for the same meaning and translation context. Prefer nested objects for new groups; do not restructure existing flat dotted keys or rename unrelated keys solely for consistency. Keep the package name in the namespace, not repeated inside each key.

evidence.excerpt:
## Which languages the application offers

The application's own locale files are the list. `client/locales/index.ts` decides what the browser offers and `server/locales/index.ts` what the server does, so adding a language means adding its file and loader entry on the side that needs it — there is no configured list to keep in step.

To add a language to the server, add its file annotated with `AppServerResource` (for example `server/locales/ja-JP.ts`) and its loader entry in `server/locales/index.ts`; the client side is described in [frontend copy and translations](frontend/references/i18n.md).

A plugin's locale file supplies translations for those languages, never a new one. A plugin shipping `ja-JP` to an application that does not offer Japanese puts nothing in the picker. Prefer keeping the client and server lists aligned when server-produced text needs the language. A client-only language is also valid: the interface switches to it, `POST /api/i18n/locale` records English for the server, and the language control explains the fallback with an informational notice.

## Default language

`i18n.defaultLocale` in `config.yml` names the language the application starts in, for the browser and the server alike:

```yaml
i18n:
  defaultLocale: zh-CN
```

It defaults to `en-US`, and `APP_DEFAULT_LOCALE` overrides it. A value the application does not translate is ignored on the client and falls back on every key on the server.

The browser resolves its startup language as: the visitor's saved choice in `localStorage` → `i18n.defaultLocale` → `en-US`. The browser's own `navigator.language` is deliberately not consulted — the language an application starts in is the product's decision, not the visitor's operating system's. A default is never written to storage as though the visitor had chosen it, so changing configuration still reaches anyone who has not picked a language. Refresh after changing it.

Switching language in the interface remains a user-level choice: it writes `localStorage` and the server session, and never changes `defaultLocale`.

## What an untranslated key falls back to

A key missing from the language in use is looked up in `i18n.defaultLocale`, and then in `en-US`:

```text
the language in use  →  i18n.defaultLocale  →  en-US
```

The second step is what an application adding a language its plugins have not translated relies on. An application defaulting to `zh-CN` that adds `es-ES` leaves a plugin with neither, and English is the one language that plugin almost certainly ships — a Spanish speaker reading English is a worse result than reading Spanish, and a better one than reading Chinese.

## Where copy lives

| File                      | Purpose                                                                                     |
| ------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `client/locales/en-US.ts` | English; also defines the structure of the copy and exports the type `AppResource`          |
| `client/locales/zh-CN.ts` | Chinese; typed as `AppResource`, so its structure must match the English                    |
| `client/locales/index.ts` | One dynamic `import()` per language, so the browser downloads only the language being shown |

Rules:

- Each new feature gets its own group (`projects: { … }`), which holds all of the feature's copy.
- Add menu titles to the existing `navigation` group (`navigation.projects`), and write `navigation: { title: 'navigation.projects' }` in the route (see `page.md`).
- Add the key to `en-US.ts` first, then add the same key to `zh-CN.ts`. A key missing from `zh-CN.ts` or extra in it (including a misspelled one) fails type checking.
- **Keys passed to `t()` are not type-checked.** `t('projects.titel')` compiles, and the page shows `projects.titel` as is. So always look at the page in both languages (see "Checks").
- When you copy structure from the reference pages (`client/pages/reference/`), move the copy into the feature's own group in `client/locales/`. The reference pages' copy is in `client/pages/reference/locales/`; it is not part of the build, so do not reference it.
